meanings.morph: ending -e (nominative singular after der/die/das; feminine accusative)

sentences.text: Letzte Woche war ich in Rom.
sentences.en: Last week I was in Rome.

sentences.text: Wann hast du ihn das letzte Mal gesehen?
sentences.en: When did you last see him?

sentences.text: Das letzte Buch von ihm hat mir nicht gefallen.
sentences.en: I didn't like his last book.

meanings.notes: REVIEW warning: The morph note is incomplete. It omits neuter accusative after das (e.g. 'Wann hast du ihn das letzte Mal gesehen?'). It also omits the strong-ending feminine accusative without an article ('Letzte Woche', 'letzte Nacht'). Add these cases to the morph description.
